name: Ihrashkovyj kit
source:
Vivien is an ordinary man who is always happy and lucky. But was he really? Or maybe this is just a secret that needs to be revealed? Because he doesn't think there are cats that can talk.

[Translated from [url=https://foiely.itch.io/toycat]itch.io[/url]]
